name: Druid
diceAnatomy: 1-3 = Claw (A), 4-5 = Paw (B), 6 = Nature (C). Vérifié leaflet (scan user 2026-07-06).
source: Board + leaflet + 14 cartes scannés user 2026-07-06. Spec complète : characters/Druid/SPEC.md. Rulings user : Thick Hide contre par Claw toujours / prévention Bear seulement ; Nature's Cure = AACC ; Wound = 1 dmg upkeep + d6 4-6 retire.

tokens.name: Shape Shift
tokens.description: Unique Status Effect. Spend at ANY time: Transform into Bear Form / Cat Form / return to Druid Form. May not be removed or transferred by any other means.

tokens.name: Regenerate (face 2)
tokens.description: Positive. Upkeep: heal 2, flip to face 1. Gaining a 2 at stack cap may flip a 1 to the 2 side. Total regen tokens (2+1 faces) capped at 2.

tokens.name: Wound
tokens.description: Negative. Afflicted player is dealt 1 dmg during their Upkeep Phase, then rolls 1 die: on 4-6, remove this token (per token).

forms.druid: At the conclusion of your turn, gain Regenerate 2 (1v1: self).
forms.cat: If you conclude your Offensive Roll Phase with an Attack, add 2 dmg and inflict Wound. Attack Modifier.
forms.bear: Your Defensive Ability is stronger (see Thick Hide).

abilities.notes: Lance 2d6, dégâts = somme (E=7). Si Bear Form : peut relancer un des deux (E~8.2). Maul II : identique (l'upgrade vaut par son alt Savage Maul).
Ruling user : pattern AACC. Gain Regenerate (2) + 5 dégâts.
Gain 1 CP et 2 Shape Shift. Puis, si Druid Form, pioche 1.

altAbilities.notes: Gain Shape Shift, puis active MAUL II (2d6 somme, reroll Bear).
1v1 : sur soi — gagne 1 CP et 2 Regenerate (2).

passives.name: Formes (overlay)
passives.text: Druid: fin de ton tour +Regenerate 2. Cat: attaque conclue -> +2 dmg et inflige Wound. Bear: Thick Hide renforcée (4 dés + prévention).

defense.name: Thick Hide
defense.text: Defense Roll 2 (Bear: 4). Deal 1 dmg per Claw. If in Bear Form: prevent 1 per Paw + 1 per Nature. (Hors Bear : aucune prévention — ruling user.)

cards.name: Maul II
cards.text: BBBB: Roll 2 dice and deal dmg equal to the total roll value. If in Bear Form, you may re-roll one of these dice. Adds alt SAVAGE MAUL (BBBBB): Gain Shape Shift. Then activate MAUL II.

cards.name: Ferocity II
cards.text: AAA: 5. AAAA: 6. AAAAA: 7. On 3-of-a-kind (#'s), inflict Wound.

cards.name: Protect the Forest II
cards.text: CCCC: Gain Regenerate 2 and Shape Shift. Then deal 8 undefendable dmg. Adds alt RAINFALL (CCC): A chosen player gains 1 CP and 2 Regenerate 2.

cards.name: Hibernate!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Transform into Bear Form (if not already). Gain Regenerate 2.

cards.name: Ready to Pounce!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Transform into Cat Form (if not already). Inflict Wound on a chosen player.

cards.name: Nature's Rest!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Return to Druid Form (if not already). Draw 1.

cards.name: Nature's Cycle!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Flip any one Regenerate 1 token to the Regenerate 2 side.

cards.name: Fey Lure!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. A chosen player gains Regenerate 2. (1v1 : soi.)

cards.name: Lethal Swipe!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action, Attack Modifier. If in Cat Form, roll 5 dice: Add 1 x Claw dmg. On 2 Paws, inflict Wound.

cards.name: Surprise Bite!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action, Attack Modifier. If in Cat Form, your Attack becomes undefendable.

cards.name: Strength of the Woods!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. If in Druid Form, roll 1 die: On Claw, deal 2 dmg to a chosen opponent. On Paw, gain Shape Shift. On Nature, Heal 3.

cards.name: Shrug Off!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Play only after being Attacked. If in Bear Form, prevent 2 dmg.

cards.name: Don't Poke the Bear!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Play only after being Attacked. If in Bear Form, deal 2 dmg.
